cleaner.label: Ollama
cleaner.description: Models downloaded by Ollama. Does not touch Ollama's configuration or keys.

option.label: Ollama models
option.description: Removes the models and their files. Close Ollama before proceeding.
option.warning: The models disappear from `ollama list`: to get them back, run `ollama pull` again. Models created locally with `ollama create` exist only here.
